stories.title: Sources: Browns tab Watson, not Sanders, as starting QB
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson will open the season as the Cleveland Browns' starting quarterback, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Brown out as GM of 1st-place Astros after skid
stories.summary: Dana Brown is out as the Houston Astros' general manager, the team announced Monday.

stories.title: TE to go from Browns to LSU in historic twist
stories.summary: The Browns are waiving tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who has an agreement in place for the 2026 season to play for LSU if he clears waivers, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Kyle Lincoln told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Manfred on CBA talks: 'We want to play' in '27
stories.summary: MLB commissioner Rob Manfred, amid uncertainty about whether labor negotiations will affect the 2027 season, said "we're planning on playing baseball next year."

stories.title: Sources: True freshman Brandon wins Vols' QB job
stories.summary: Tennessee has named true freshman Faizon Brandon as the Volunteers' starting quarterback, sources told ESPN, after he beat out George MacIntyre for the job.
